title: Community-Focused Academic Brings AI Tools to Colorado Farmers
zh_title: 以社区为中心的学术界为科罗拉多州农民带来人工智能工具
summary: 科罗拉多州东部的许多农民和牧场主对人工智能感到好奇，但他们没有当地精通技术的人来向他们展示如何使用人工智能。薛“爱丽丝”董已将此作为她的工作。董是 IEEE 高级会员，也是科罗拉多州立大学推广部门（CSU 的外展部门）的推广区域专家。她在洛根县工作，为科罗拉多州东北角的 10 个县农业区提供服务。她的工作是将大学研究转化为对居住在那里的人们的实际帮助。薛“爱丽丝”东 雇主 科罗拉多州立大学洛根县扩建项目 Tit
content:
科罗拉多州东部的许多农民和牧场主对人工智能感到好奇，但他们没有当地精通技术的人来向他们展示如何使用人工智能。薛“爱丽丝”董已将此作为她的工作。董是 IEEE 高级会员，也是科罗拉多州立大学推广部门（CSU 的外展部门）的推广区域专家。她在洛根县工作，为科罗拉多州东北角的 10 个县农业区提供服务。她的工作是将大学研究转化为对居住在那里的人们的实际帮助。薛“爱丽丝”董 雇主 科罗拉多州立大学洛根县推广 职称 推广区域专家 会员等级 高级会员 母校内蒙古师范大学，位于呼和浩特；北京师范大学；纽约州立大学环境科学与林业学院，位于锡拉丘兹；科罗拉多州立大学全球分校 她构建了人工智能驱动的农业旅游聊天机器人 (AgriTourismAI.com)，帮助农民和牧场主启动和经营“农业旅游”业务。农业旅游是指农民向游客开放他们的土地以进行娱乐、教育或购物活动。常见的例子包括采摘自己的果园、如何种植蔬菜的课程以及手工产品的销售。董还举办研讨会，向农民和牧场主展示如何使用人工智能工具来帮助发展和管理他们的业务。她说她将自己视为大学和农村之间的纽带。 “我们（推广专家）充当桥梁，”她说。
“我们将校园与我们服务的农村社区联系起来。”许多农民和牧场主年龄较大，通常没有接受过技术培训。他们的子孙常常离开农场到城市工作，或者无法教他们新工具。如果没有帮助，人工智能的好处可能会与农民失之交臂。 Dong 的研讨会为他们提供了一条出路。Dong 凭借她的 AgriPivot AI Agent 入围 2026 年 GenAI for Good Challenge 决赛。该挑战赛由 IEEE Humanarian Technologies 和联合国国际电信联盟组织，她的项目是从 79 个国家的 318 个团队中选出的。她还获得了国家推广技术社区 (NETC) 颁发的 2026 年创新奖，以及国家社区发展推广专业人员协会 (NACDEP) 颁发的 2025 年国家和西部地区教育技术奖。作为首席研究员或联合首席研究员，她获得了七项竞争性资助，总额超过 25 万美元，其中包括由农业部国家食品和农业研究所支持的资金。董出生于北京，从小就热爱设计和解决问题。她的父母都是医生。小时候，她喜欢画新的、有创意的东西。她说，素描可以让她用图片解决脑海中的问题，并将它们作为实际设计写在纸上。这个习惯逐渐成为她与周围环境相处的一种方式。
她说：“我一直热衷于创造一些有形的东西来解决现实世界中的问题。”她并不将自己的人生方向归功于任何一位导师。相反，她说她所有的老师都帮助她为她的职业生涯奠定了基础。她就读于位于呼和浩特的内蒙古师范大学，这是一所培训教师的机构。 2013 年，她在那里获得了两个学士学位——一个是地理科学学士学位，另一个是教育学士学位。然后，她获得了课程和教学硕士学位

【原文 English Original】
Many farmers and ranchers in eastern Colorado are curious about artificial intelligence, but they don’t have a local tech-savvy person to show them how to use it. Xue “Alice” Dong has made that her job. Dong, an IEEE senior member, is an extension regional specialist with the Colorado State University Extension , CSU’s outreach arm. She works in Logan County and serves a 10-county farming area in Colorado’s northeast corner. Her job is to turn university research into practical help for the people who live there. Xue “Alice” Dong Employer Colorado State University Extension in Logan County Title Extension regional specialist Member grade Senior member Alma maters Inner Mongolia Normal University, in Hohhot; Beijing Normal University; State University of New York College of Environmental Science and Forestry, in Syracuse; Colorado State University Global She built the AI-Powered Agritourism Chatbot (AgriTourismAI.com), which helps farmers and ranchers launch and run “agritourism” businesses. Agritourism is when farmers open their property to visitors for fun, education, or shopping events. Familiar examples include pick-your-own fruit orchards, lessons on how to grow vegetables, and sales of handmade products. Dong also teaches workshops where she shows farmers and ranchers how they can use AI tools to help grow and manage their business. She says she sees herself as a link between the university and the countryside. “We [extension specialists] act as a bridge,” she says. “We bridge our campus to the rural communities we serve.” Many farmers and ranchers are older, and they typically have no technical training. Often their children and grandchildren have left the farm to work in a city or otherwise aren’t around to teach them about new tools. Without help, the benefits of AI could pass the farmers by. Dong’s workshops give them a way in. Dong was named a finalist in the 2026 GenAI for Good Challenge for her AgriPivot AI Agent. The challenge was organized by IEEE Humanitarian Technologies and the U.N.’s International Telecommunication Union , and her project was selected from 318 teams across 79 countries. She also won the 2026 Award for Innovation from the National Extension Technology Community (NETC) , and both the 2025 national and Western regional Educational Technology Awards from the National Association of Community Development Extension Professionals (NACDEP). She has secured seven competitive grants totaling more than US $250,000 as principal investigator or co-principal investigator, including funding supported by the Department of Agriculture ’s National Institute of Food and Agriculture . An early love of design and problem-solving Dong was born in Beijing. Both her parents are doctors. As a child, she liked drawing new and inventive things. Sketching, she says, lets her picture solutions to problems in her head and put them on paper as practical designs. That habit grew into a way of relating to her surroundings. “I’ve always had a passion to create something tangible that can solve problems in the real world,” she says. She doesn’t credit a single mentor for the direction her life has taken. Instead, she says all her teachers helped lay the groundwork for her career. She attended the Inner Mongolia Normal University , in Hohhot, an institution that trains teachers. She earned two bachelor’s degrees there in 2013—one in geographical science and one in education. She then earned a master’s degree in curriculum and instruction from Beijing Normal University in 2016. That year, she moved to the United States to continue her graduate studies at the State University of New York College of Environmental Science and Forestry , in Syracuse. She earned a master’s degree in environmental biology in 2020. From outreach to extension work After earning her second master’s degree, she joined Paul Smith’s College , in Paul Smiths, N.Y., as an education and outreach coordinator. She managed several national watershed projects to protect rivers, lakes, and aquifers. Watersheds are areas of land from which water drains into bodies of water. She also undertook invasive-species-prevention projects, wrote grants to secure project funding, and designed two educational websites and several outreach publications. One website, Maintain the Chain , helps lake residents, boaters, and visitors from around the world keep invasive species out of the Fulton Chain of Lakes in New York’s Adirondack Park. In 2022, she joined Stewards of the Coast and Redwoods as program manager. The nonprofit, based in Guerneville, Calif., works with California State Parks to protect, restore, and educate the public about the parks along Sonoma County ’s coast and the Russian River area. The region is known for its redwood forests, wineries, and resort towns. She left in 2023 to join the CSU Extension as a regional specialist, a title she still holds. Her employer is part of the Cooperative Extension System , a nationwide network run by land-grant universities , schools founded with federal grants to teach farming and other practical subjects. Extension faculty and staff share what researchers at their universities learn with the citizens of those states. The cooperative system operates on three levels. It is overseen federally by the Department of Agriculture ’s National Institute of Food and Agriculture , managed statewide through land-grant universities, and delivered locally by county offices and Extension agents across more than 3,000 counties. The work goes well beyond farming, Dong says, also covering community and economic development, health initiatives, and the 4-H program , which teaches children hands-on skills in agriculture, science, leadership, and citizenship. Extension faculty members’ performance is judged on their research, teaching, and service to the community, Dong says—similar to the way professors in academia are evaluated. The difference, she says, is the audience: Professors teach students; most extension specialists teach adults, including farmers, ranchers, and community leaders. The setting is different, too. Dong doesn’t commute from the campus to the countryside; she lives and works in it. Her office is in Sterling, a small rural town. But her projects serve the whole state, and many of the people she helps live one to four hours’ drive away. So, most of her work with farmers and ranchers happens by email, phone, and virtual meetings. County fairs, farmers markets, and agricultural events give her chances to meet large groups of them in person. She can’t just hand Colorado residents research findings and expect them to figure out the information they need, she says. “We need to translate that research into something more practical, and easier to use, that farmers and ranchers can understand immediately,” she says. Dong also focuses not on only on whether people use AI, but also on how they use it. In 2026, she and Paul Hill from Utah State University Extension published “From Access to Governance: Generative AI Literacy for Extension Professionals and Small Businesses, and a Governance-Aware Design Framework” in the journal AI . The paper offers a framework for helping Extension professionals and small businesses adopt generative AI responsibly. How her AI chatbot helps farmers and ranchers In 2025, Dong earned a third master’s degree , in artificial intelligence and machine learning, from CSU Global . She immediately put those skills to work on agritourism, she says. She built the chatbot in Python , a popular programming language . It answers typed questions, and its user interface looks much like ChatGPT ’s, but it works differently. Under the hood, it uses retrieval-augmented generation, a technique that has the AI look up information in a set of trusted documents before it answers. Dong curated that collection from Extension publications, so the chatbot’s answers rest on authoritative sources and are less likely to be made up. She presented the project at NeurIPS 2025 (Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems). The code is openly available on GitHub, so other Extension offices can adapt it. The bot runs in a web browser rather than as a phone app. Many farmers she works with don’t own a smartphone, Dong says, but nearly all have a computer, tablet, or other gadget that can connect to a website. The bot works on any of them, with no app to download. Extension specialists “act as a bridge. We bridge our campus to the rural communities we serve.” Farmers often ask the bot how to attract visitors and how to write a business plan. A farmer thinking about opening a corn maze, for example, can ask how to price admission, what kind of insurance to carry, and which permits to get. The bot also gives advice on managing risk. One of her test sites was Prairie Ridge Buffalo Ranch , in eastern Colorado. Dong documented how the ranch put AI to work in a peer-reviewed case study, “Revolutionizing Agritourism with AI and Machine Learning: A Case Study of Prairie Ridge Buffalo Ranch in Colorado,” published in 2025 in CABI Tourism Cases . Surveys and interviews she conducted with other users showed that people find it’s easy to use the bot, learn from it, and act on its advice, she says. She is preparing the full results for publication. Her work extends beyond agritourism. In 2026, she contributed an AI assistant to Project Pythia, an open-science program funded by the U.S. National Science Foundation and led by the National Center for Atmospheric Research (NCAR) . The AI assistant turns raw airport weather report data into plain-language guidance for farmers and other non-technical users, and it tells users when data is missing rather than guessing. She also teaches workshops on AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude , and Gemini . She has taught her workshop 20 times to more than 200 entrepreneurs and business owners, who came from 32 Colorado counties. In follow-up surveys, 90 percent of participants reported trying at least one new AI task in their business. Some of the workshops take place at a community center run by the Logan County Economic Development Corp ., in Sterling. She has also co-hosted the workshops with the Rural Community Assistance Corp ., Colorado Startup Week , and Boulder Startup Week . And she occasionally presents them as webinars, so people don’t have to travel. Her outreach has taught her that many farmers are eager to try new tools , she says. She shows them how simple her chatbot is to use. She also offers advice to high school students drawn to the field. Extension specialists each have a specialty, such as livestock, natural resources, food systems, or 4-H. Students should pick one based on their passion, she says. Land-grant universities offer related programs at the bachelor’s and master’s levels. For graduate students, she adds, Extension offers a third career path beyond academia and industry: “You apply advanced skills directly to the communities that need them.” How IEEE membership supports her career Dong joined IEEE in 2025 and soon was elevated to senior member. Her professional home is the IEEE Society on Social Implications of Technology . She also serves as vice treasurer of the IEEE Denver Section’s Young Professionals group . IEEE supports all three parts of her job, she says. For research, she presented “Entrepreneur AI Agent: Empowering Small Businesses and Bridging the Digital Divide through Context-Aware Generative AI” at the 2026 IEEE Global Humanitarian Technology Conference (GHTC). For teaching, she has offered to bring her AI workshop to Denver Section members and local entrepreneurs. For service, she reviews papers for IEEE conferences. IEEE conferences matter most to her, she says: “Through them, I can present my research and network with other researchers in the field.” She attended the IEEE World Forum on Public Safety Technology in Boulder, Colo., in September 2026. The event, she says, opened her eyes to many new projects underway across IEEE. Still, she says, her work always points back to the farms and ranches of eastern Colorado. Its people are curious, she says, but they can’t make the leap to new technology alone. “They really need this kind of a bridge,” she says.

特朗普向习近平和普京示好，中等强国纷纷采取行动
周四，在深圳举行的亚太经合组织峰会期间，俄罗斯总统普京、中国领导人习近平和美国总统唐纳德·特朗普抵达麒麟山庄参加三边会议时合影留念。 |泳池 / 法新社-JIJI

北京/东京 — — 当唐纳德·特朗普总统本周试图重塑围绕大国的世界秩序时，美国的两个盟友将目光投向了华盛顿以外的地区。加拿大在北京找到了机会。日本与中国发生争执，转而寻求亚洲其他地区的合作伙伴。
周四，当特朗普与中国领导人习近平和俄罗斯总统普京在深圳湖畔别墅参加亚太经合组织领导人峰会的会议时，他们的中等强国外交蒙上阴影。
特朗普吹嘘它“比 1945 年雅尔塔会议还要大”，美国、英国和苏联在这次会议上瓜分了战后欧洲。

As Trump courts Xi and Putin, middle powers make their own moves
Russian President Vladimir Putin, Chinese leader Xi Jinping and U.S. President Donald Trump pose for photos as they arrive for a trilateral meeting at Kylin Villa on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen on Thursday. | POOL / VIA AFP-JIJI
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
Beijing/Tokyo – As President Donald Trump sought to reshape the world order around great powers this week, two U.S. allies looked beyond Washington. Canada found an opening in Beijing. Japan, at odds with China, turned to partners elsewhere in Asia.
Their middle-power diplomacy was overshadowed on Thursday when Trump joined Chinese leader Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin at a lakeside villa in Shenzhen for a meeting that dominated the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation leaders’ summit.
Trump boasted it was “bigger than Yalta,” the 1945 conference at which the United States, Britain and the Soviet Union divided up postwar Europe.

summary: 发言人办公室 美国参加2026年东亚峰会情况介绍 2026年11月18日 在11月17日于菲律宾马尼拉举行的东亚峰会上，美国重申对自由开放印太的承诺，表示支持东盟中心地位，并强调美国是该地区首选的能源和技术伙伴。为在美国与东盟建立关系50周年之前推进全面战略伙伴关系，美国和东盟通过了《落实美国-东盟领导人共识的全面工作计划》
content:
发言人办公室 美国参加2026年东亚峰会情况介绍 2026年11月18日 在11月17日于菲律宾马尼拉举行的东亚峰会上，美国重申对自由开放印太的承诺，表示支持东盟中心地位，并强调美国是该地区首选的能源和技术伙伴。为了在美国-东盟关系成立50周年之前推进全面战略伙伴关系，美国和东盟通过了《实施美国-东盟领导人共同愿景声明的综合工作计划，以促进东盟和美国更强大、更安全和更繁荣》（2026-2030年）。美国强调其与盟友和伙伴一道致力于加强威慑，以维护印太地区的和平与稳定。在两国建交80周年之际，美国祝贺菲律宾成功担任东盟轮值主席国。促进和平，加强自由开放的印太地区 美国将继续在印太地区发挥领导作用，并威慑该地区任何试图通过武力解决争端的国家，这体现了特朗普总统通过实力实现和平的承诺。
美国将继续维护《联合国海洋法公约》所反映的国际法规定的所有国家行使航行和飞越自由的权利，包括在南中国海。台海的和平与稳定对于印太地区的安全与繁荣仍然至关重要，美国反对任何单方面改变现状的行为。美国仍然致力于实现朝鲜完全无核化，并全面执行联合国安理会所有涉朝决议。扩大贸易、能源和技术联系美国仍然是东盟最大的单一国家外国直接投资者，截至 2025 年，该地区的外国直接投资超过 5,570 亿美元，为美国提供了约 532,000 个就业岗位。美国祝贺东盟领导人签署《数字经济框架协议》，该协议有可能为美国科技公司提供更大的机会，让该地区的数字经济到2030年将达到2万亿美元。随着美国超级智能（SI）技术在全球树立黄金标准，美国正在与东南亚伙伴合作，扩大获得美国技术的机会，包括通过美国-东盟SI SPARK计划，这将有助于释放该地区的经济潜力。

Office of the Spokesman The United States’ Participation in the 2026 East Asia Summit Fact Sheet November 18, 2026 At the East Asia Summit in Manila, Philippines on November 17, the United States reaffirmed its commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific, expressed support for ASEAN centrality, and underscored the United States as the region’s preferred partner for energy and technology. To advance their Comprehensive Strategic Partnership ahead of the 50 th anniversary of U.S.-ASEAN relations, the United States and ASEAN adopted the Comprehensive Work Plan to Implement the U.S.-ASEAN Leaders’ Joint Vision Statement to Promote a Stronger, Safer, and More Prosperous ASEAN and America (2026-2030). The United States highlighted its commitment, with allies and partners, to strengthen deterrence to safeguard peace and stability in the Indo-Pacific region. The United States congratulated the Philippines on a successful ASEAN chair year, as the two countries mark 80 years of diplomatic relations. Promoting Peace and Strengthening a Free and Open Indo-Pacific Reflecting President Trump’s commitment to peace through strength, the United States will continue to lead in the Indo-Pacific and deter any nation in the region tempted to settle disputes by force. The United States will continue to uphold the right of all nations under international law as reflected in the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Seas (UNCLOS) to exercise freedom of navigation and overflight, including in the South China Sea. Peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait remain essential to the security and prosperity of the Indo-Pacific and the United States opposes any unilateral change to the status quo. The United States remains committed to the complete denuclearization of the DPRK and the full implementation of all DPRK-related UN Security Council resolutions. Expanding Trade, Energy, and Technology Ties The United States remains ASEAN’s largest single country foreign direct investor, with more than $557 billion in foreign direct investment in the region as of 2025, which supports an estimated 532,000 American jobs. The United States congratulated ASEAN leaders for signing the Digital Economy Framework Agreement, which has the potential to provide U.S. technology companies with greater opportunities in the region’s digital economy projected to reach $2 trillion by 2030. As American Super Intelligence (SI) technology sets the gold standard worldwide, the United States is working with Southeast Asian partners to expand access to U.S. technology, including through the U.S.-ASEAN SI SPARK program, which will help unlock the region’s economic potential. As one of the world’s largest energy producers, the United States can power Southeast Asia’s growth for generations. The United States is ready to work with ASEAN to strengthen the region’s energy security through support for the ASEAN Power Grid. The United States is sharing its 70 years of experience and leadership in nuclear energy by promoting nuclear safety, security, and nonproliferation in Southeast Asia. Building on our existing 123 Agreements with Indonesia and Vietnam, the United States has entered into 123 Agreements with the Philippines, Singapore, and Thailand, and launched negotiations with Malaysia. This cooperation will help the region meet its growing energy demand, including reliable power for SI. The United States is expanding civil nuclear cooperation in Southeast Asia, where energy demand is anticipated to triple by 2050. Consistent with the U.S.-Japan-South Korea Memorandum of Cooperation (MOC) on Small Modular Reactor (SMR) deployments, the United States is providing SMR control room simulators and other technical assistance to Indonesia under the Department’s Foundational Infrastructure for the Responsible Use of Small Modular Reactor Technology (FIRST) program to help establish Indonesia as a regional SMR hub. Combating Scams and Transnational Crime Scam groups based in Southeast Asia stole at least $18.2 billion from Americans and around $23 billion from citizens of ASEAN member states in 2025. In response, President Trump issued Executive Order 14390, titled “Combating Cybercrime, Fraud, and Predatory Schemes Against American Citizens,” and the Department of State has confronted these criminal groups head on. The Department is directing an additional $26.2 million to train and equip Southeast Asian law enforcement and criminal justice officials to work with U.S. law enforcement to catch and prosecute scam network operators. The United States and 12 regional partners in the Contact Group to Counter Criminal Online Scams agreed to a Statement of Principles to drive joint action to dismantle the scam syndicates targeting our people. content:

澳大利亚国防部长理查德·马尔斯并不担心这份报告，“因为 AUKUS 正在发生”
发表于 2026 年 11 月 22 日 08:37
更新于 2026 年 11 月 22 日 08:48
澳大利亚国防部长理查德·马尔斯表示，美国国会预算办公室声称 AUKUS 将减少美国攻击潜艇的说法是“错误的”。
AUKUS将从2027年起将弗吉尼亚级潜艇引入澳大利亚，并于2030年左右开始销售，并推出新的英澳级潜艇。
堪培拉已承诺在 30 年内拨款 3680 亿澳元，而中国则称 AUKUS 危险，并警告称这可能会加剧军备竞赛。
悉尼 - 澳大利亚国防部长理查德·马勒斯 (Richard Marles) 11 月 22 日批评美国国会预算办公室的一份报告，该报告称 AUKUS 协议将减少美国海军可用的攻击潜艇数量。
“他们错了，”马勒斯说，他指的是国会预算办公室，该机构在 11 月份的报告中表示，向澳大利亚出售弗吉尼亚级潜艇可能会在 2060 年之前缩小海军攻击潜艇部队的规模。
AUKUS是澳大利亚有史以来最大的国防项目，将从2027年开始在澳大利亚部署美国指挥的弗吉尼亚级潜艇，包括从2030年左右开始向澳大利亚出售几艘弗吉尼亚级潜艇，并将让英国和澳大利亚建造新型AUKUS核动力潜艇。
马尔斯在电视讲话中表示，他并不担心这份报告，“因为 AUKUS 正在发生”，而且“美国的生产率绝对在增加”。
10 月，Marles 表示，澳大利亚仍有望在 2030 年代初从美国购买第一艘核动力潜艇。
国会预算办公室没有立即回应正常工作时间之外的置评请求。
堪培拉已承诺在三十年内向 AUKUS 提供 3,680 亿澳元（3,145.6 亿新元），其中包括对英国和美国生产基地的数十亿美元投资。
AUKUS 成立于 2021 年，是对抗中国在印太地区日益增长的影响力的一部分。
中国称该协议很危险，并警告称它可能会引发地区军备竞赛。路透社
澳大利亚阿尔巴内斯表示，在特朗普致电后，AUKUS 仍“全速前进”

Australia's Defence Minister Richard Marles was not worried about the report “because AUKUS is very much happening”
Published Nov 22, 2026, 08:37 AM
Updated Nov 22, 2026, 08:48 AM
Australia’s Defence Minister Richard Marles said the US Congressional Budget Office was “wrong” to claim AUKUS would reduce US attack submarines.
AUKUS will bring Virginia-class submarines to Australia from 2027, with sales from around 2030 and a new UK-Australia submarine class.
Canberra has committed A$368 billion over 30 years, while China calls AUKUS dangerous and warns it could fuel an arms race.
SYDNEY - Australian Defence Minister Richard Marles on Nov 22 criticised the United States Congressional Budget Office over a report that said the AUKUS pact would decrease the number of attack submarines available to the US Navy.
“They are wrong,” Marles said, referring to the CBO, which said in the report in November that the sale of Virginia-class submarines to Australia could diminish the size of the navy’s attack submarine force through to 2060.
AUKUS, Australia’s largest-ever defence project, will put US-commanded Virginia-class submarines in Australia from 2027, involves selling several Virginia-class submarines to Australia from around 2030 and will have Britain and Australia build a new class of AUKUS nuclear-powered submarine.
Marles was not worried about the report “because AUKUS is very much happening” and “the production rate in the United States is absolutely increasing”, he said in televised remarks.
In October, Marles said Australia remained on track ​to acquire its first ​nuclear-powered subs from the US in the early 2030s.
The CBO did not immediately respond to a request for comment outside regular business hours.
Canberra has committed A$368 billion (S$314.56 billion) over three decades to AUKUS, including billions of dollars in investment in British and US production bases.
Formed in 2021, AUKUS is part of efforts to counter China’s growing influence in the Indo-Pacific.
China has called the pact dangerous and warned it could spur a regional arms race. REUTERS

content:
【大紀元2026年11月22日訊】（大紀元記者鍾又淳報導）現年46歲的香港男星方力申，11月20日在IG宣布太太葉萱（Maple）懷上第二胎，並通過套娃揭曉寶寶性別。當得知二胎將迎來兒子，方力申幽默直呼：「我不是岳父相呀！」
視頻中，方力申身穿粉色上衣，笑稱不少朋友都說他很有「岳父相」，原本以為二胎還會是女兒。結果，大女兒Isla一層層打開粉藍相間的俄羅斯套娃，最裡面出現藍色小套娃，證實是男寶寶。
方力申與太太又驚又喜，直呼猜錯了，並興奮對著鏡頭大喊「我不是岳父相，是湊成好字」。（點看視頻）
據港媒報導，方力申日前前往醫院探望住院的父親時，在醫生安排及家人見證下完成了這場揭曉。
方力申與葉萱於2025年2月宣布結婚，同年底迎來女兒Isla，當時父女倆頭貼頭的合照，令網友驚呼「簡直一模一樣」。如今再添男丁，方力申提到，因考量太太情況及自己已年過40，醫生安排了多項無創產前檢測。
有女萬事足的方力申，每一次分享女兒的照片，都是對女兒成長的記錄，也讓人感受到他對家庭的珍視。
現年46歲的方力申，身兼運動員與藝人身分，在體壇與演藝圈都成績不俗。他9歲開始習泳，曾代表香港參加奧運、亞運、東亞運及大學生運動會等賽事，至今仍是多項游泳項目的香港紀錄保持者。前不久，他在IG發文透露，為了捕捉完美角度，他一隻手抱著女兒，另一隻手用力高舉手機拍照，導致脊背拉傷，連呼吸都痛，被迫放棄了原定參加的一場游泳大賽。
方力申官宣二胎並揭曉是男寶後，其社交平台迅速被祝福聲刷屏。網友紛紛留言「恭喜小方兒女雙全」、「真正湊成了一個『好』字」。也有人調侃他終於成功打破了朋友笑稱的「終極岳父相」魔咒。
在宣布喜訊的第二天，方力申挑戰35公里港澳慈善泳，為基層及有特殊學習需要的兒童和青少年籌款。網友稱讚他是兼顧家庭與公益的「絕世好爸」。

content:
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和中国国家主席习近平一致认为，即使两国争夺人工智能霸主地位，人类也应该始终参与使用人工智能技术的军事决策，美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特周五表示。特朗普在中国深圳与习近平会面归来后，贝森特对 CNBC 表示，该协议是特朗普亚洲之行的主要成果之一。贝森特表示：“我认为，特朗普总统和习主席一致认为，人类应该始终参与情报情报机构做出的任何军事决策，并且不应允许情报情报机构在重大军事行动中自主行事，这一点非常重要。”贝森特指的是特朗普政府对该技术的首选术语“超级智能”。贝森特表示，美中就该技术的军事使用达成的协议需要人类参与和其他保障措施，不会受到两国人工智能霸主竞争的影响。他补充说，美国人工智能实验室需要保持其技术领先地位，作为抵御网络攻击中使用的“危险”中国人工智能模型的最佳防御手段。贝森特说：“但是，当双方都同意不应该在无人参与的情况下发起任何重大军事行动时，这与竞争无关。”
他表示，涉及英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋和一名与他有恋情的中国公民的间谍指控并未在特习双边会晤中提及。贝森特表示，在特朗普采取他所谓的“非常强硬的路线”后，英伟达的第二级人工智能芯片 H200 仍然是中国可以通过许可购买的最先进的芯片。 “我认为我们看到的是中国人在 H200 上的订单很少，因为他们试图构建自己的芯片堆栈，而且我认为他们可能落后了很多年，”他补充道。英伟达丑闻发生后，贝森特淡化了财政部长和商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克在人工智能芯片限制问题上所表达的分歧，称特朗普政府官员“都致力于遵循特朗普总统的指示”。美国商务部周一采取措施，进一步限制中国获得先进人工智能芯片，包括中国实体可以租用计算能力的海外数据中心使用的芯片。 “我认为我们将会看到适当的芯片限制已经到位，并且远程访问已经被限制，”他说。

【原文 English Original】
President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping agreed humans should always be involved in military decisions that use artificial intelligence technologies, even as the two countries compete for AI supremacy , Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Friday. Bessent told CNBC after returning from Trump’s meeting with Xi in Shenzhen, China, that the agreement was among the major achievements of Trump’s trip to Asia. “I think it was very important that President Trump and President Xi agreed that humans should always be involved in any military decisions that SI makes, and the SI should not be allowed to be autonomous for major military actions,” Bessent said, referring to the Trump administration’s preferred term for the technology, “super intelligence.” Bessent said that the U.S.-China agreement on military use of the technology, requiring human involvement and other safeguards, would not be affected by the two countries’ competition for AI supremacy. He added that U.S. AI labs needed to maintain their technological lead as the best defense against “dangerous” Chinese AI models that are being used in cyberattacks. “But there’s nothing to do with competition when it says that both sides agree that no major military operation should be launched without a human being involved,” Bessent said. He said that the spying allegations involving former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and a Chinese national that he was romantically involved with did not come up in the Trump-Xi bilateral meeting. Bessent said that Nvidia’s second-tier AI chip, the H200, remained the most advanced chip that China could purchase with licenses, after Trump took what he called a “very firm line.” “I think what we have seen is a paucity of orders from the Chinese on the H200s as they try to build out their own chip stack, and I think that they are probably many years behind,” he added. Bessent downplayed differences that he had voiced between the views of Treasury and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick on AI chip restrictions in the wake of the Nvidia scandal, saying Trump administration officials were “all committed to following President Trump’s instructions.” The Commerce Department took steps on Monday to further restrict China’s access to advanced AI chips, including those used by overseas data centers where Chinese entities can rent computing power. “I think we are going to see that the proper chip restrictions are in place, and the remote access has been curtailed,” he said.

title: The military lacks an ‘overarching plan’ to improve munition stockpiles—partly because it’s no one’s job
zh_title: 军方缺乏改善弹药库存的“总体计划”——部分原因是这不是任何人的工作
summary: 根据政府问责办公室周四发布的一份研究报告，国防部没有确定、实现或衡量其在实现长期弹药生产目标方面取得的进展的“总体计划”，该研究称军方对全球事件过于敏感，并且没有准备好预测自己的需求。美国政府问责局指出，除其他问题外，武器库存缺乏集中权力，武器库存已因伊朗战争而耗尽，对美国与中国发生潜在冲突的计划至关重要。问题的核心在于军队可以购买的东西和实际需要的东西之间的差异。
content:
根据政府问责办公室周四发布的一份研究报告，国防部没有确定、实现或衡量其在实现长期弹药生产目标方面取得的进展的“总体计划”，该研究称军方对全球事件过于敏感，并且没有准备好预测自己的需求。美国政府问责局指出，除其他问题外，武器库存缺乏集中权力，武器库存已因伊朗战争而耗尽，对美国与中国发生潜在冲突的计划至关重要。问题的核心在于军方可以购买的东西与实际需要的东西之间存在差异，政府问责局表示，这甚至可能导致弹药投资超出五角大楼的要求。该报告的作者写道：“虽然国防部正在采取措施关注弹药短缺问题，但它无法解决这些差距。” “国防部没有总体计划，也没有指定和授权的领导层来改善弹药库存并满足其弹药需求。由于没有确定长期目标、实现这些目标的战略以及衡量进展的指标，国防部无法确定其行动能否解决弹药短缺问题。”包括国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯在内的高级政府官员否认美国存在弹药短缺，尽管有报告和独立分析显示，伊朗冲突已经严重耗尽了弹药。关键武器，特别是备受追捧的爱国者拦截机，其制造时间可能超过两年。
但在对政府问责局研究的回应中，五角大楼官员同意军方需要制定一项长期计划来提高弹药生产的建议。五角大楼负责采购的代理副手大卫·卡德曼写道：“我们同意需要一个总体框架，更好地整合弹药需求、库存水平、生产、资源和长期目标。”他补充说，国防部“已经执行了政府问责局建议中的许多内容”。美国政府问责局的研究并未探讨特定弹药的库存，而是研究了五角大楼跟踪、预测和总体处理一系列武器（从炮弹到战斧导弹）的过程。 “重要的是，[这项研究]与当前的短缺无关，”战略与国际研究中心的高级顾问马克·坎西恩（Mark Cancian）撰写了大量有关弹药政策的文章。 “这关系到未来并决定长期库存、生产和弹药组合。”  国防官员强调需要“高低”弹药组合，即高科技、难以制造的武器和廉价武器之间的平衡。伊朗战争说明了美军对昂贵拦截机的依赖，这些拦截机投入了大量资金来击落廉价的沙赫德无人机，这些无人机的成本只有数万美元。
彭博资讯国防分析师韦恩·桑德斯表示：“当你拥有先进的能力，并且开始消耗先进的能力来击落快速补充的非先进能力时，这是一场我们赢不了的经济游戏。”“这开始转变为军事领域的一场革命，表明我们必须改变我们的学说，同时改变我们在美国的生产能力。”   美国政府问责局国防能力主管戴安娜·摩尔达夫斯基 (Diana Moldafsky) 在周五发给《防务一号》的一封电子邮件中指出，五角大楼已经发现了不足之处

【原文 English Original】
The Defense Department has no “overarching plan” to identify, achieve, or measure its progress toward long-term munition production goals, according to a Government Accountability Office study released on Thursday, which said the military was too reactive to global events and unprepared to forecast its own needs. The GAO cited—among other issues—a lack of centralized authority over weapons inventories, which have been depleted by the Iran war and are vital to U.S. plans for a potential conflict with China. At the center of the problem lies a discrepancy between what the military can buy and what it actually needs, which the GAO said could even result in munition investments that exceed the Pentagon’s requirements.  “While DOD is taking steps to focus on munitions shortages, it is not positioned to address these gaps,” the report’s authors wrote. “DOD does not have an overarching plan or designated and empowered leadership to improve munition inventories and meet its munitions requirements. By not identifying long-term goals, strategies to achieve them, and metrics to gauge progress, DOD cannot be sure that its actions will address its munition shortfalls. ” Top administration officials, including Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, have denied that the U.S. has a shortage in munitions, despite reports and independent analyses showing the Iran conflict has alarmingly drained key weapons, especially for highly-sought Patriot interceptors that can take more than two years to make. But in its response to the GAO study, Pentagon officials concurred with the recommendation that the military needed to develop a long-term plan to improve its munition production.  “We agree with the need for an overarching framework that better integrates munition requirements, inventory levels, production, resources, and long-term objectives,” wrote David Cadman, the Pentagon’s acting deputy for acquisitions, who added that the department “already executes many elements” of the GAO’s recommendation. The GAO study did not explore the inventories of specific munitions, but examined the processes by which an expansive list of weapons — from artillery shells to Tomahawk missiles — are tracked, forecast and generally addressed by the Pentagon. “The important thing is that [the study] is not about current shortages,” Mark Cancian, a senior adviser with the Center for Strategic and International Studies who has written extensively on munitions policy. “It's about the future and deciding long-term inventories, production, and munitions mixes.”  Defense officials have emphasized the need for a “high-low” mix of munitions—that is, a balance between high-tech, hard-to-make weapons and cheaper ones. The Iran war illustrated the U.S. military’s reliance on expensive interceptors, which were heavily expended to shoot down cheap Shahed drones that only cost tens of thousands of dollars.  “When you have an exquisite capacity, and you are starting to expend an exquisite capacity to knock down non-exquisite capabilities that are rapidly replenished, it is an economical game that we're not going to win,” said Wayne Sanders, a defense analyst with Bloomberg Intelligence. “This is starting to turn into one of those revolutions in military affairs to say we have to change our doctrine as well as we change our production capacity in the U.S.”   In an email to Defense One on Friday, the GAO’s director for defense capabilities, Diana Moldafsky, noted that the Pentagon had identified shortfalls before the conflict with Iran, but said that the war “made addressing those shortages more urgent.” “Our key point is that meeting DOD's munitions requirements will be challenging,” Moldafsky said. “A department-wide plan would help the department direct its resources towards its most critical munitions needs.”  Cancian said that Russia’s 2022 full-scale invasion of Ukraine, and the consequent transfer of Patriots and other weapons to Kyiv, introduced concerns about the defense industrial base and its ability to respond to munition needs around the world. Meanwhile, the Pentagon has inked billions of dollars in multi-year “framework agreements” with top defense companies over the last year to help increase high-tech munition production, which require funding from Congress to come to fruition. The Trump administration also invoked the Defense Production Act earlier this year in an attempt to bolster munition supply chains. A Pentagon spokesperson declined to address the GAO study directly, or even to be quoted by name. But they said the military is “fully equipped to strike at the time and place of the President’s choosing…while preserving a deep, ready stockpile to defend our people and interests.” Part of the problem is that no one authority is really in charge of keeping arsenals topped off and ready, the report found.  The GAO identified several Pentagon offices and working groups, including individual service entities, responsible for managing munition inventories, but no one dedicated authority “that empowers the leadership to make decisions that improve munitions inventories department-wide and hold them accountable for the outcomes achieved, such as improving munitions inventory levels.” The study also said that the services maintain separate tools to track munition inventories, which then feed into a Pentagon system known as the Munitions Readiness Initiative. But researchers said the DOD has limited oversight over that tracking platform and hasn’t regularly reconciled it with service-level numbers. Citing an unnamed Pentagon official in its acquisitions and sustainment office, the GAO said “the office was reluctant to impose additional responsibilities on the services for maintaining data to meet MRI’s needs because they recognize that the services already face numerous responsibilities in managing their own munitions inventory data.” The Pentagon concurred with most of the GAO’s recommendations, but only partially agreed with one: that the data management plan be run out of the DOD’s digital and AI office. Cadman’s response said that the Pentagon’s acquisition and sustainment arm was best suited to develop it. ]]>

Nobody’s going to play games with us.” ( Watch ) On Iran: “They want to make a deal, but I want a deal that can be lasting… If we have a bad President, a weak President, I want a deal that will supersede the President… One way or the other, we’ll finish it off.” ( Watch ) On working with Democrats in the new Congress: “I’ve been called by Democrats at a level that’s pretty amazing. Nobody would even believe it… They want to make deals. I have the veto power… I have a feeling that this is going to be an unbelievably productive two years. Because they’ll send me a bill on healthcare, and I’ll say no way, and I’ll veto it, and then they’ll call me… and we’ll sit down.” ( Watch ) On Super Intelligence : “I was with President Xi all night last night, sitting next to him at the dinner, right on his right-hand side, and we spoke the whole evening, and we talked about that, and he’s amazed at how well we’ve done with that. We’re leading China, we’re leading the whole world.” ( Watch ) On reports of an Iranian dirty bomb plot: “There is indication that Iran is looking at gas and they’re looking at the bio — the biological weapons, not nice — and other things, and we’ll see… These are nasty people… Look, if it does happen, we wipe them out.” ( Watch ) On Obama driving China and Russia together: “The relationship should have never been allowed to happen. You know, they were natural enemies, but because of Obama, not Biden, it was Obama before, he drove them together because of energy. … All my life I read you never want to have Russia and China team up… What can I tell you? They both like Trump.” ( Watch ) The post ICYMI: President Trump Talks China, Iran, Super Intelligence, and the Path Ahead in Exclusive Interview from Shenzhen appeared first on The White House .

title: 看BIGBANG演唱會獲GD點名稱讚 周潤發幽默回應
summary: 周潤發（發哥）資料照。(Woohae Cho/Getty Images) 【大紀元2026年11月22日訊】《大紀元記者佟亦加報導）韓國天團BIGBANG日前在香港舉行一連4場演唱會，吸引不少圈中名人到場支持。在最後一場演出中，隊長權志龍（G-Dragon，簡稱GD）在台上特別點名感謝影帝周潤發（發哥），稱讚他是「永遠年輕的超級巨星」，引發全場轟動。對於被稱讚「永遠年輕」，現年71歲的發哥21日受訪時幽默回應：「他們（的年齡）加起來都沒有我厲害。」 據港媒報導，11月21日，
content:
周潤發（發哥）資料照。(Woohae Cho/Getty Images)
【大紀元2026年11月22日訊】《大紀元記者佟亦加報導）韓國天團BIGBANG日前在香港舉行一連4場演唱會，吸引不少圈中名人到場支持。在最後一場演出中，隊長權志龍（G-Dragon，簡稱GD）在台上特別點名感謝影帝周潤發（發哥），稱讚他是「永遠年輕的超級巨星」，引發全場轟動。對於被稱讚「永遠年輕」，現年71歲的發哥21日受訪時幽默回應：「他們（的年齡）加起來都沒有我厲害。」
據港媒報導，11月21日，周潤發率領黃浩然、蔡一智等藝人參加「樂施毅行者」20公里賽事時，證實自己到場欣賞了BIGBANG的17日在香港的最後一場演出，並大誇讚精彩。對於獲GD稱讚「永遠年輕」，向來喜歡掌控手機自拍的發哥延續幽默風格，笑稱「他們（的年齡）加起來都沒有我厲害」，逗樂眾人。
BIGBANG目前活躍的三名成員分別為太陽（Taeyang）、G-Dragon（權志龍）與大聲（Daesung）。截至2026年11月，三人的實際周歲年齡分別為38歲、38歲和37歲。
談及當晚在後台與BIGBANG合影的趣事，一向習慣親自拿機自拍的發哥透露，對方團隊的拍照管理非常嚴格，「手機在他們經紀人那裡，我想拿自己的手機拍照都不行，一定要用主辦方的相機」。
不過，周潤發幽默表示，自己其實只是陪老婆陳薈蓮去看演唱會。而當被問及太太最喜歡BIGBANG哪位成員時，他秒答：「三個都喜歡，她就是不喜歡我而已！」再次引起全場大笑。
事實上，GD一直是周潤發的忠實影迷，兩人早在2015年的Mnet亞洲音樂大獎（MAMA）上便已結緣，當時發哥曾親自為BIGBANG頒獎。此後兩人在MAMA頒獎禮及香港時裝秀等場合多次重逢和互動。
早前GD也曾公開表示，周潤發在經典電影《英雄本色》中飾演的「Mark哥」，對他的舞台風格及藝術表達有著深遠影響。此次兩人在香港的演唱會上同場，再度展現了跨世代巨星之間的惺惺相惜。

title: Mysterious MQ-25 Stingray-Like Chinese Drone Emerges At Little-Known Flight Test Center
zh_title: 神秘的MQ-25类似黄貂鱼的中国无人机出现在鲜为人知的飞行测试中心
summary: 卫星图像显示，中国浦城有一架不寻常的无人驾驶飞机，其配置与波音公司的舰载 MQ-25 Stingray 非常相似。虽然我们仍然不知道无人机的功能，但该设施本身似乎也成为中国不断扩大的无人驾驶飞机工业的一个日益重要的枢纽。 Vantor 向 TWZ 提供的宽视野卫星图像显示了 2026 年 4 月 23 日位于浦城的神秘无人机。卫星图像 ©2026 Vantor 这架无人机最初在浦城内府机场的卫星图像中被发现后引起了人们的关注。
content:
卫星图像显示，中国浦城有一架不寻常的无人驾驶飞机，其配置与波音公司的舰载 MQ-25 Stingray 非常相似。虽然我们仍然不知道无人机的功能，但该设施本身似乎也成为中国不断扩大的无人驾驶飞机工业的一个日益重要的枢纽。 Vantor 向 TWZ 提供的一张广角卫星图像显示了 2026 年 4 月 23 日在蒲城的神秘无人机。卫星图像 ©2026 Vantor 这架无人机最初引起了人们的关注，因为它在中国西北部陕西省蒲城内府机场的卫星图像中被发现，可通过苹果地图查看。无人机出现在跑道上的单独图像也可以通过必应地图获得。 TWZ 随后从 Vantor 获得了浦城的图像，显​​示了相关无人驾驶飞机。真是一个惊喜！苹果地图上发现三架无人机出现在浦城。 CH-7、九天和类似MQ-25的无人机。 pic.twitter.com/rREqLuFAdU — Charles Xu (@CharlesXu091121) 2026 年 11 月 18 日再次出现在 bing 地图上！这次它出现在跑道上 pic.twitter.com/xLgZetmOZf — Charles Xu (@CharlesXu091121) 2026 年 11 月 19 日 除了不明飞行器之外，今年 4 月从蒲城拍摄的图像还揭示了似乎是 CH-7 隐形飞翼无人机和重型喷气动力九天母舰无人机的例子。 2026 年 4 月 23 日，一架 CH-7 停泊在蒲城。
卫星图像 ©2026 Vantor 2026 年 4 月 23 日在蒲城的九天无人机母舰。卫星图像 ©2026 Vantor 与不明飞行器最明显的比较是波音的 MQ-25 Stingray。 MQ-25是一种舰载无人飞机，主要为美国海军飞机提供空中加油，扩大舰载机联队的航程和操作灵活性。它还为未来无人海军航空能力奠定了基础。范托称，就尺寸而言，这架身份不明的中国无人机翼展约为66英尺，长度为49英尺。相比之下，MQ-25 的翼展约为 75 英尺，长度约为 51 英尺。 MQ-25 黄貂鱼。波音公司的这款中国无人机似乎具有相似的总体设计类别，但现阶段存在一些值得注意的重要差异。最引人注目的之一是前机身。与MQ-25不同，MQ-25的前部具有相对扁平的铲状外观，中国飞机似乎有一个更传统的锥形机头。也许这可以包含一个容纳雷达设备的锥形天线罩。这个理论，而且它只是一个理论，可以通过机头与黄色底漆机身的不同颜色来支持。进气量也不同。
与 MQ-25 相关的异国情调的齐平进气道不同，中国设计有一个更传统的背部进气道，看起来呈锯齿状，有助于雷达信号和/或分成两个通道。另一种可能性是飞机有两个发动机，尽管基于明显的分叉进气道，这仍然是推测性的。左侧浦城图像中的无人机和 MQ-25 的并排视图，提供了它们入口的比较视图。卫星图像 ©2026 Vantor/Boeing 尾部配置也可能很独特，具有横向展开的 V 型尾翼，如 MQ-25，但可能采用可见控制面，而不是全移动水平尾翼设计。综合起来，这些功能

【原文 English Original】
Satellite imagery has revealed an unusual uncrewed aircraft at Pucheng, China, with a configuration that bears very strong similarities to Boeing’s carrier-based MQ-25 Stingray . While we still have no idea about the function of the drone, the facility itself also appears to be an increasingly important hub for China’s expanding uncrewed aircraft industry . A wider-view satellite image provided to TWZ by Vantor shows the mystery drone at Pucheng on April 23, 2026. Satellite image ©2026 Vantor The drone initially attracted attention after being spotted in a satellite image of Pucheng Neifu Airport in Shaanxi Province, in northwestern China, available through Apple Maps. A separate image of the drone, where it appears on a runway, is also available through Bing Maps. TWZ subsequently obtained imagery of Pucheng from Vantor showing the uncrewed aircraft in question. what a suprise! Three UAV spotted at Pucheng on apple maps. CH-7, Jiutian and a MQ-25 like UAV. pic.twitter.com/rREqLuFAdU — Charles Xu (@CharlesXu091121) November 18, 2026 spotted again on bing maps! and it's on the runway this time pic.twitter.com/xLgZetmOZf — Charles Xu (@CharlesXu091121) November 19, 2026 As well as the unidentified aircraft, imagery from Pucheng dating from April of this year also reveals what appears to be a CH-7 stealthy flying-wing drone and an example of the heavyweight jet-powered Jiutian mothership drone . A CH-7 at Pucheng on April 23, 2026. Satellite image ©2026 Vantor A Jiutian drone mothership at Pucheng on April 23, 2026. Satellite image ©2026 Vantor The most obvious comparison for the unidentified aircraft is Boeing’s MQ-25 Stingray. The MQ-25 is a carrier-based uncrewed aircraft developed primarily to provide aerial refueling for U.S. Navy aircraft, extending the range and operational flexibility of carrier air wings. It also provides a foundation for future uncrewed naval aviation capabilities . In terms of dimensions, the unidentified Chinese UAV has a wingspan of approximately 66 feet and a length of 49 feet, according to Vantor. In contrast, the MQ-25 measures approximately 75 feet in wingspan and 51 feet in length. MQ-25 Stingray. Boeing The Chinese drone appears to occupy a similar general design category, but there are several important differences notable at this stage. One of the most noticeable is the forward fuselage. Unlike the MQ-25, whose forward section has a relatively flattened, shovel-like appearance, the Chinese aircraft appears to have a more conventional, tapered nose. Perhaps this could incorporate a conical radome housing radar equipment. That theory, and it is just a theory, could be supported by the different color of the nose compared to the yellow primer-painted airframe. The air intake is also different. Rather than the exotic, flush inlet associated with the MQ-25 , the Chinese design has a more conventional dorsal intake that appears serrated to help with radar signature and/or split into two channels. Another possibility is that the aircraft has two engines, although that remains speculative, based on the apparent bifurcated intake. A side-by-side look at the drone seen in the image of Pucheng, at left, and an MQ-25, offering comparative views of their inlets. Satellite image ©2026 Vantor/Boeing The tail configuration may also be distinctive, with a laterally flared V-tail, like the MQ-25, but possibly incorporating visible control surfaces instead of an all-moving tailplane design. Taken together, these features suggest an aircraft that shares some of the MQ-25’s general design philosophy but is not an attempt at a direct clone. Long-time Chinese aerospace observer and TWZ contributor Andreas Rupprecht , who has been following developments surrounding the aircraft, believes China could be following a development path similar to Boeing’s, potentially producing a carrier-based uncrewed aerial refueling platform that can also undertake intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) missions. “I think China is actually following the same path as Boeing here, and it’s heading towards a tanker that can also take on other roles as an ISR platform,” Rupprecht told us. A radar-equipped aircraft with substantial endurance could potentially perform surveillance and other sensor-related missions when not being used as a tanker. The potential development of a multirole uncrewed tanker at Pucheng would also fit into a much broader push by China to expand the role of uncrewed aircraft in its naval aviation forces. One of the most notable developments is the GJ-21 , a navalized derivative of the GJ-11 Sharp Sword stealth uncrewed combat air vehicle (UCAV). Featuring folding wings and provisions for catapult launches and arrested recoveries, the low-observable flying-wing design is intended to operate from China’s growing fleet of large-deck warships , including the Type 076 amphibious assault ship Sichuan . In October 2026, Chinese state media reported that the GJ-21 had successfully completed its first takeoff and landing aboard the vessel, a significant milestone in the development of shipborne fixed-wing combat drones. GJ-21 carrier-based UCAV. via Chinese internet The GJ-21 effort is taking place alongside the introduction of China’s new catapult-equipped Fujian aircraft carrier, which has begun operating the J-35 stealth fighter, J-15T carrier-based fighter, and KJ-600 airborne early warning aircraft. Taken together, these developments point to an increasingly ambitious effort to integrate uncrewed aircraft into China’s future carrier air wings , potentially spanning stealthy strike platforms, surveillance systems, and other specialized support aircraft. The unidentified Pucheng aircraft could represent another, quite different part of that wider effort — or something else altogether. At the same time, this aircraft is roughly 20 percent dimensionally smaller than the MQ-25, which would mean it would have less fuel to give. It’s also worth noting that Boeing’s MQ-25 emerged from an unmanned combat air vehicle (UCAV) design that included low-observable features. Multirole UCAV concepts predating it also looked very similar. The MRE concept from Lockheed during the 1990s looks very similar to the MQ-25 we know today. (Lockheed Martin) In addition, Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA), for instance, the FQ-42 Vengeance, and also the XQ-67 Off-Board Sensing Station share a similar overall design. With this in mind, and remembering its different nose section, this could just as easily be a true multirole UCAV or even a CCA, such as one designed for force protection of high-value aerial assets, and it may not even be carrier-capable. Rupprecht cautioned that the manufacturer of the mystery drone remains unidentified. However, one of the more interesting clues about the aircraft’s possible origins comes from Shenyang Aircraft Corporation (SAC). Rupprecht pointed to a propeller-driven demonstrator unveiled by SAC in 2025, which he believes could fit the development lineage of the larger aircraft now visible at Pucheng. The sub-scale propeller-driven demonstrator unveiled by SAC in 2025. The background reads (rough translation): “Rollout Ceremony for Final Assembly of Shenyang’s First ‘Surrogate Flight Test’ Pilot-Test Verification Platform UAV.” via Chinese internet A smaller, propeller-driven demonstrator could provide a relatively inexpensive way to investigate aerodynamic characteristics, autonomous flight controls, mission systems, and other technologies before progressing to a much larger aircraft. This piston-powered, propeller-driven aircraft with a broadly similar configuration to the MQ-25 was seen in a video flying, as well. 突然想起中国一家民营无人机公司，做过一款MQ-25活塞桨叶版 https://t.co/Y69dfzpLNS pic.twitter.com/IzU08PC8DK — 飞刀 (@chaoyinsukandao) November 18, 2026 Whether the Pucheng aircraft is related to this SAC demonstrator or if it’s an entirely separate program remains unknown. Beyond the external resemblance, there are no indications that they are linked, and the aircraft could just be a general test surrogate platform. The configuration isn’t totally novel in the advanced UAS world. The aircraft’s appearance is also interesting given the location where it has been spotted. Pucheng Neifu Airport is located in Shaanxi Province, and its surrounding aviation facilities include an area identified in Apple Maps as the National Aeronautics Industrial Base Pucheng General Aviation Industrial Park Guanliban. The industrial park has its own smaller runway, separate from the main airport infrastructure. A close-up of Pucheng with no drones visible, as of June 16, 2026. Satellite image ©2026 The site had remained relatively obscure to outside observers until roughly the past one to two years, according to Rupprecht. More recently, however, various aircraft manufacturers have apparently been conducting testing there. This raises the possibility that Pucheng is not simply an individual manufacturer’s flight-test location, but a facility used by multiple organizations developing and evaluating uncrewed aircraft. Rupprecht also raised the possibility that Pucheng could potentially be a specialized uncrewed aircraft testing facility associated with China’s Flight Test Establishment at Xi’an, commonly known as CFTE. “I cannot say (yet) whether this — and this is my theory — is effectively a branch of the CFTE at Xi’an, which is for crewed and this is a base for uncrewed ones,” Rupprecht explained. A satellite image provided to TWZ by Vantor provides an overview of Pucheng as of April 23, 2026. Satellite image ©2026 Vantor If Pucheng does serve as a shared testing location for multiple manufacturers, it could help explain the appearance of several otherwise unrelated UAV designs at the same site. Returning to the mystery drone, the combination of its apparent size, configuration, and possible connection to earlier Chinese demonstrator programs makes it an interesting development to watch. Regardless, for now, the imagery from Pucheng offers a glimpse of a potentially significant new Chinese uncrewed aircraft program. Contact the author: thomas@thewarzone.com The post Mysterious MQ-25 Stingray-Like Chinese Drone Emerges At Little-Known Flight Test Center appeared first on TWZ .

content:
经过一周繁忙的发射活动，本周全球发射清单预计将进行六次发射，其中包括范登堡发射的 3 次 SpaceX 猎鹰 9 号发射任务、中国的两次发射任务以及南美洲的阿丽亚娜 6 号发射任务。 SpaceX 将为美国太空部队和国家侦察办公室发射有效载荷，而本周的中国任务和阿丽亚娜 6 号任务中至少有一次将发射一批互联网卫星。长征2D |有效载荷未知，将于 11 月 18 日星期三从中国发射，长征 2D (CZ-2D) 预计将于世界标准时间 22:50 从太原卫星发射中心的 9 号发射场 (LC-9) 发射。官方警告通知表明发射轨迹是向南的，但有效载荷及其预定轨道的详细信息要等到发射后才会发布。两级、40.77 米高的 CZ-2D 由上海航天技术研究院 (SAST) 制造。 2D 版本不需要额外的捆绑式助推器。此次飞行将是长征2D的第108次飞行，也是今年的第七次。猎鹰 9 号 | USSF-317 (R-6) SpaceX 将于 11 月 18 日星期三进行本周两次发射中的第一次发射，发射时间为四小时，发射窗口于太平洋标准时间晚上 7:00（世界标准时间周四 03:00）开始。
USSF-317 任务是美国太空军 (USSF) 本周的唯一任务，将从加利福尼亚州范登堡太空部队基地 (VSFB) 的东 4 号航天发射场 (SLC-4E) 发射，向东南飞行，将其机密有效载荷送入低地球轨道 (LEO)。所有系统看起来都很好，天气也有利于升空。猎鹰 9 号发射的 USSF-627 任务即将开始从加利福尼亚州发射推进剂 → https://t.co/IdlZbviZZl pic.twitter.com/fKxyN4DIui — SpaceX (@SpaceX) 2026 年 11 月 12 日助推器 B1100 将支持此次任务，这是自近一年前 11 月 23 日首次支持星链集团 11-30 以来的第十一次飞行， 2025 年。除了 NROL-105 和 USSF-385 之外，助推器之前的八次飞行支持了星链任务。 SpaceX 的西海岸无人机飞船 Of Course I Still Love You 将在 B1100 升空后约 8 分钟着陆时驻扎在地面。猎鹰 9 号是一枚直径 3.9 米、高 70 米的两级火箭。九台 Merlin 1D 发动机为第一级助推器提供动力，而第二级则使用一台真空优化的 Merlin 发动机。猎鹰 9 号和猎鹰重型火箭是第一批实现定期重复使用的轨道火箭，其中一枚猎鹰助推器已飞行 37 次。飞行后，两个有效载荷整流罩也被回收并重复使用。长征8A | SatNet LEO Group 本周的第二次中国发射计划于 11 月 11 日星期五举行。
世界标准时间 20 日 11:00，在中国文昌航天发射场的商业 LC-1 发射台上发射。长征 8A (CZ-8A) 将携带 9 颗通信卫星进入近地轨道，这些卫星由 SatNet 拥有并由中国卫星网络集团运营。 CZ-8A火箭有两个直径3.35米的级，总高度为50.54 m。第一级由两个捆绑式液体燃料助推器辅助。此次飞行将标志着 CZ-8A 的第 13 次飞行，也是 2026 年的第七次飞行。 NROL-136 SpaceX 本周的第二次猎鹰 9 号任务定于 11 月 21 日星期六太平洋标准时间凌晨 4:30（世界标准时间 12:30）发射，同样是从加州 VSFB 的 SLC-4E 发射。 NROL-136 任务将携带未知数量的有效载荷进入近地轨道，供国家侦察办公室 (NRO) 的增殖建筑星座使用，该星座由 Space 建造

【原文 English Original】
Following a week of busy launch activity, the worldwide launch manifest is set to see six launches this week, with three SpaceX Falcon 9 missions from Vandenberg, two Chinese missions, and an Ariane 6 mission from South America. SpaceX will launch payloads for the United States Space Force and the National Reconnaissance Office, while at least one of this week’s Chinese missions and the Ariane 6 will launch a batch of internet satellites. Chang Zheng 2D | Unknown Payload Wednesday, Nov. 18, will see a launch from China, with a Chang Zheng 2D (CZ-2D) expected to launch from Launch Complex 9 (LC-9) at the Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center at 22:50 UTC. Official warning notices indicate a southerly launch trajectory, but details of the payload and its intended orbit will not be released until after launch. The two-stage, 40.77-m-tall CZ-2D is manufactured by the Shanghai Academy of Spaceflight Technology (SAST). The 2D variant requires no additional strap-on boosters. This flight will mark the 108th CZ-2D to fly, the seventh of this year. Falcon 9 | USSF-317 (R-6) SpaceX’s first of two launches this week comes on Wednesday, Nov. 18, at the start of a four-hour launch window that opens at 7:00 PM PST (03:00 UTC on Thursday). The only mission for the United States Space Force (USSF) this week, the USSF-317 mission will launch from Space Launch Complex 4 East (SLC-4E) at Vandenberg Space Force Base (VSFB) in California, flying southeast to place its classified payload into low-Earth orbit (LEO). All systems are looking good, and weather is favorable for liftoff. Propellant load is about to begin for Falcon 9’s launch of the USSF-627 mission from California → https://t.co/IdlZbviZZl pic.twitter.com/fKxyN4DIui — SpaceX (@SpaceX) November 12, 2026 Booster B1100 will support this mission, marking its eleventh flight since first supporting Starlink Group 11-30 nearly a year ago on Nov. 23, 2025. Eight of the booster’s previous flights supported Starlink missions, in addition to flying NROL-105 and USSF-385. SpaceX’s west coast droneship, Of Course I Still Love You, will be stationed downrange for B1100’s landing approximately eight minutes after liftoff. Falcon 9 is a 3.9-m-diameter, 70-m-tall two-stage rocket. Nine Merlin 1D engines power the first-stage booster, while the second stage uses a single vacuum-optimized Merlin engine. Falcon 9 and Falcon Heavy were the first orbital rockets to achieve regular re-use, with one Falcon booster having flown 37 flights. The two payload fairings are also recovered and reused after flight. Chang Zheng 8A | SatNet LEO Group The second Chinese launch of the week is scheduled for Friday, Nov. 20, at 11:00 UTC from the Commercial LC-1 pad at the Wenchang Space Launch Site in China. A Chang Zheng 8A (CZ-8A) will carry nine communications satellites into LEO, with the satellites owned by SatNet and operated by the China Satellite Network Group. The CZ-8A rocket features two 3.35-m-diameter stages, with a total height of 50.54 m. The first stage is assisted by two strap-on liquid-fuelled boosters. This flight will mark the 13th overall CZ-8A flight, the seventh of 2026. Falcon 9 | NROL-136 SpaceX’s second Falcon 9 mission of the week is scheduled to launch on Saturday, Nov. 21, at 4:30 AM PST (12:30 UTC), again from SLC-4E at VSFB in California. The NROL-136 mission will carry an unknown number of payloads into LEO for the National Reconnaissance Office’s (NRO) Proliferated Architecture constellation, built by SpaceX and Northrop Grumman. The booster supporting this mission will be B1097, flying for the 14th time. This booster first flew on Sept. 3, 2025, and has previously flown eight Starlink missions, as well as NROL-172, Transporter 17, Sentinel-6B, Twilight (Pandora & Others), and USSF-259. Following stage separation, B1097 will conduct a return-to-launch-site landing at Landing Zone 4 (LZ-4), located directly next to SLC-4E. Ariane 64 | Amazon Leo (LE-04) Amazon is continuing to put together its constellation of Leo satellites and will add another 36 on Monday, Nov. 23, at 10:12 UTC aboard an Ariane 64. The rocket will launch from Ensemble de Lancement Ariane 4 (ELA-4) at the Guiana Space Centre in French Guiana, with the launch window lasting five hours and 27 minutes. Ariane 64 will follow a northeastern trajectory, delivering 22,000 kg of Leo satellites into LEO. Ariane 64 is a 62-m-tall, 5.4-m-diameter, expendable two-stage rocket built by the ArianeGroup on behalf of the European Space Agency. Both stages are powered by liquid hydrogen and oxygen-fuelled engines. The 64 variant of the basic Ariane 6 utilizes four P129 strap-on solid rocket boosters to provide additional lift-off thrust. This will be the fifth Ariane 6 mission of 2026. Watch the full replay of #VA269 . Relive Ariane 6's successful mission carrying 36 Amazon Leo satellites into orbit. First flight with P160C boosters Heaviest Ariane payload ever #LaunchingAmbitions #Ariane6 #VA269 @Amazonleo @ArianeGroup @esa @CNES @EuropeSpacePort pic.twitter.com/YLxW60wAo1 — Arianespace (@Arianespace) June 17, 2026 Falcon 9 | USSF-266 (TH-3) Closing out the week, a Falcon 9 launch is currently scheduled for Monday, Nov. 23, at 8:04 AM PST (16:04 UTC) — the third this week from SLC-4E at VSFB. The classified USSF-266 mission has a four-hour launch window extending to 12:04 PM PST (20:04 UTC). Falcon 9 will fly due south, indicating a polar orbit for the payload. While the payload is classified, the launch trajectory and other factors suggest that this may be an additional batch of satellites for the USSF’s Space-Based Airborne Moving Target Indicator (SB-AMTI) program. These are based on the SpaceX Starshield satellite bus. The Falcon 9 booster supporting this flight will be B1081, making its 29th flight. B1081 first flew on Aug. 26, 2023, and flew four missions from SpaceX’s Florida launch sites before moving to Vandenberg for Transporter 10, where it has operated since then. The booster will land atop Of Course I Still Love You , stationed approximately 640 km downrange in the Pacific Ocean. If the current schedule holds, this will mark the 122nd Falcon 9 flight of 2026, and the 273rd orbital launch attempt worldwide in 2026. (Lead Image: Falcon 9 launches into the Florida morning skies. Credit: Julia Bergeron for NSF) The post Launch Preview: Ariane 6 to launch Amazon satellites, Falcon 9 to launch government missions appeared first on NASASpaceFlight.com .
